reviews.name: Shell and Signal
reviews.premise: A warm shell white and a deep ink, with one sharp vermilion that only ever means: this needs you.
logo_ideas: A hinge: two arcs meeting at one sharp point, the place where a shell's halves join
A closed form with a single vermilion dot held inside it, like a pearl
A lowercase o built from two offset half-shells

reviews.name: Deep Water
reviews.premise: The sea the name comes from: a blue-green abyss and a pale shell, with coral as the one warm signal.
logo_ideas: Concentric growth lines, like the rings a shell lays down over time: work that keeps its history
An open arc around a solid dot: something valuable inside a protective curve
A rounded tile whose lower edge rises like a tide line

reviews.name: Graphite and Safety
reviews.premise: Tool-grade and built to last: graphite and paper, with safety yellow for the one thing that needs a human.
logo_ideas: A heavy, machined shell outline with one yellow notch where it opens
Two interlocking halves of a shape that close without a gap, like a hinge built to tolerance
A solid geometric mark with a single round cutout: the pearl as negative space
